headline: Explosion at Augsburg train station – two injured, closure lifted
lead: An explosion occurred at Augsburg train station early this morning. Police are on the scene with a large-scale operation. Train services were temporarily suspended.
seo_title: Explosion at Augsburg Central Station: Several slightly injured
social_title: Explosion at Augsburg Central Station: Police and rescue services in major operation
print_title: Explosion at Augsburg Central Station: Several slightly injured
print_subtitle: Parts of the station area were cordoned off on Wednesday morning due to a major police operation.
summary_bullets_en: An explosion occurred in a building passage at Augsburg's main train station, slightly injuring several people. The cause remains unclear.
Police operation caused disruptions in commuter and road traffic. Duration of closures is currently unknown.
Windows were damaged; the extent of further structural damages is under investigation.

body.caption: The area around Augsburg main station is cordoned off during the operation.

body.text: _ehj./jsc._ A large-scale police operation was underway at Augsburg main station since shortly after 5 a.m. The reason was an explosion in a building passageway. According to the German Press Agency, two people were slightly injured. They reportedly suffered acoustic trauma.

According to initial information, an unknown object exploded in a building passageway opposite the station around 3:15 a.m. The injured included a 17-year-old and an 18-year-old. According to police, both were Ukrainians. Window panes were also damaged by the explosion, police said. Investigators assumed they were coincidentally in the area as passers-by.

After the discovery of another suspicious object, police completely cordoned off the main station at 8:30 a.m. and suspended train services. The German Press Agency, citing police, reported that the object proved harmless after police investigations, and the station closure was lifted after about an hour and a half.
The police operation also affected road traffic and public transport. At 10:15 a.m., police announced that train services had resumed.
